title: autoresearch: one lead agent, a notebook of files, code that measures and refuses
subtitle: The overview. Dashed boxes are called only when needed. Red borders: points that can refuse. The detail with every box and tool is architecture.md. Generated from overview.json; archdraw.py check keeps it in step with the code.

steps.label: 3 Experiments run, several at a time

nodes.label:
You
goal, decisions,
TEST OK, promotion
nodes.note: gives the prompt, answers decisions in chat; nothing of yours is acted on unless it is recorded with your words

nodes.label:
Promotion gate
your OK + one TEST
nodes.note: a version becomes the champion only with your recorded OK and one TEST check; run.py refuses otherwise

nodes.label:
Research agent
only on a trigger
nodes.note: runs when the open branches are used up, two rounds were flat, a card needs an unknown technique, a gap changed, or you ask; writes notes only

nodes.label:
Lead agent
plans the round, tracks the best
nodes.note: reads the notebook, says in ten lines what the round is, writes the cards, updates the best versions; does small planning and coding inline

nodes.label:
Experiment agents
plan, code, train, evaluate
nodes.note: one per card, in parallel (GPU slots); a variant needs no agent at all

nodes.label:
Fresh critic
cards, shared code, headline numbers
nodes.note: fresh context; accepts, revises or rejects; never judges what it wrote

nodes.label:
Notebook (plain files)
problem, findings, closed questions, queue,
best versions, ledger, decisions, handover
nodes.note: the only memory across sessions and chats; what a new chat reads first is the handover

nodes.label:
Measuring code and gates
run.py, decide.py, evaluation, provenance, lineage,
machine lock, hold marker, guard hook
nodes.note: a run starts only with a card, a free slot, no other chat's lock; the verdict comes from a rule written before the run; protected files only with your decision
